sloka: किं न स्मरसि तद्युद्धे प्रथमे मत्पराक्रमम्।निबद्धस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा यदा भुवि विवेष्टसे ।। ६.८९.९ ।।
transliteration: kiṁ na smarasi tadyuddhe prathame matparākramam।nibaddhastvaṁ saha bhrātrā yadā bhuvi viveṣṭase ।। 6.89.9 ।।

translations.english: "Do you not remember that in the first combat your brother bound by me had fallen on the ground. Why do you not remember my valour?"
